name: VIES VAT number validator
description: Checks EU VAT numbers against the European Commission's VIES service, so Rackflow can apply reverse charge to business customers with a valid number.
author: Rackflow

settings.label: Your VAT country
settings.help: Two letter VIES country code of your own VAT number, for example DE, or EL for Greece. Set it together with your VAT number to receive a consultation number for each check, the evidence a tax authority accepts.

settings.label: Your VAT number
settings.help: Your own VAT number without the country code. Leave both fields empty to check numbers without a consultation number.

settings.label: VIES endpoint
settings.help: The Commission's REST address. Use https://ec.europa.eu/taxation_customs/vies/rest-api/check-vat-test-service to try the plugin with the test numbers.

provides.label: EU VIES
provides.description: Online check of EU VAT numbers with the European Commission.
